headline: Knicks Lead Tonight's NBA Slate
caption:
Three NBA games tonight, and our model's surest pick is in the Garden.

The Knicks are its most confident call at 74% against the 76ers, projected 114.9 to 107.5. Not a lock: Philly takes this one about 1 time in 4.

The one to watch is Thunder at Spurs. The model leans San Antonio at just 52%, with projections of 113.3 to 112.7. That's a coin flip, and OKC wins it nearly half the time. Elsewhere, Detroit is a 59% pick at home over Boston, projected 109.7 to 107.1.

Swipe for every pick, win probability and projected score. Which call would you flip?

games.game: Oklahoma City Thunder at San Antonio Spurs
